content.title: THE MINERALS YOUR DOCTOR NEVER TESTS FOR
facts: **Manganese** (Bone Builder) — Pineapple | Brown Rice | Chickpeas | Sweet Potato
**Iodine** (Thyroid Fuel) — Seaweed | Cod | Iodized Salt | Shrimp
**Copper** (Energy Spark) — Oysters | Cashews | Shiitake Mushrooms | Dark Chocolate
**Selenium** (Immune Shield) — Brazil Nuts | Sardines | Eggs | Sunflower Seeds
**Potassium** (Heart Rhythm) — Coconut Water | Sweet Potato | White Beans | Banana
**Zinc** (Wound Healer) — Pumpkin Seeds | Lentils | Chickpeas | Cashews
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Most people have never had their **manganese** checked, yet it quietly activates the enzymes your body uses to build bone and repair connective tissue — low levels can leave joints and bones weaker than they should be. **Iodine** works behind the scenes too: your thyroid grabs it to make T3 and T4, the hormones that set your metabolism's pace, so even a mild shortage can leave you tired and puffy without an obvious cause. Then there's **selenium**, which fuels an antioxidant enzyme called glutathione peroxidase that protects your cells from damage and helps your thyroid convert hormones into their active form. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and get labs checked if something feels off.

At @smarthealthfix, we break down nutrition, common health issues, organs, and small daily habits so you actually understand what your body needs instead of guessing. Our mission is to help you build small, realistic habits instead of chasing quick fixes.
